jobs.title: Research Analyst - Global Growth Equity
jobs.description:
Do you want to use your fundamental equity market expertise and portfolio management knowledge to help manage portfolios and identify new investment opportunities? Are you a strong communicator who works well in a team-oriented structure? Do you want to be a part of a growing business within a well-established asset management platform?

We’re looking for a Research Analyst - Global Growth Equity to:

• assist lead portfolio managers with research activities on US and Global equities that reflect the investment strategies for our client mandates
• identify and assess new and existing investment opportunities using both fundamental bottom-up company driven analysis and top-down market level research
• help implement and manage investment strategies, support product workflows and models, and monitor performance and risks
• effectively communicate portfolio performance and positioning to key stakeholders
• coordinate research efforts with internal teams
• support the improvement of our processes and proprietary portfolio management systems

• Develop and maintain effective relationships with stakeholders, senior management, and peers across Group Compliance and Operational Risk Control (GCORC).

jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.description:
Are you excited to work with a global team with diverse backgrounds and talents? Can you apply your technical skills to help quantify business risks? Do you enjoy the challenge of driving business impact through analytics and are looking for an opportunity to lead innovation?

We’re looking for a Data Scientist to:

• engage in audits to analyze data using traditional machine learning or Large Language Models to uncover trends, patterns, or anomalies for auditors to investigate further.
• work collaboratively with stakeholders to assist in risk assessments and highlight high-risk areas for deep dives.
• clearly communicate complex insights derived from analytics to senior stakeholders in a manner that is both engaging and impactful.
• stay up to date with advancements in AI, ML, and NLP to implement cutting-edge solutions, such as working with the latest Large Language Models (LLMs).
• provide auditors with training and support, as required, to effectively use data-driven tools and solutions.

jobs.title: APAC Sanctions Officer
jobs.description:
• Handle Sanctions-related advisory and escalations, and provide subject matter expertise (SME) on core risk areas to all relevant stakeholders in APAC across all Lines of Business
• Execute the team’s day-to-day activities, including assessments of customer relationships with nexus to sanctioned countries and/or persons, transaction- and securities escalations, reputational risk reviews, drafting and negotiation of sanctions related legal clauses in collaboration with General Counsel (Legal), analysis and commenting on new regulatory and internal requirements, etc
• Dealing with significant complex Sanctions issues, requiring detailed analysis and/or external legal advice/interaction with regulators etc
• Assist with the continued effective implementation and refinement of a robust Sanctions risk and controls framework in APAC, in consultation with the Global Sanctions team
• Produce and assist with maintenance of all relevant management information, including regular and accurate reporting to Management
• Participate in regional and global projects and working groups; assist with internal audits, compliance monitoring & testing reviews
• Deliver targeted Sanctions training to ensure employees in their areas of coverage receive training commensurate with the level of risk associated with their job responsibilities

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
Are you interested in starting your journey as a Product Manager and working closely with Operations and Technology teams? Are you passionate about improving end user experience and using data and technology— including AI — to drive meaningful operational change?
We’re looking for a Product Manager (AO) to join the Collateral Crew, specifically within the Margin & Interest Workflow pod. The pod is responsible for driving meaningful change in margin call issuance processes, leveraging AI and automation to improve accuracy, efficiency, and user experience.
You will work closely with Operations users and the collateral crew to understand pain points, support delivery of solutions, and help ensure successful rollout and adoption.

Key responsibilities would include, but are not limited to:
• Support ownership of one or more Collateral Operations products or services within the Margin & Interest Workflow pod.
• Work closely with Collateral Operations users to understand day to day margin and interest workflows and identify pain points.
• Help identify opportunities to improve efficiency, reduce risk, and enhance user experience, particularly within margin call issuance processes.
• Assist in capturing and translating stakeholder requirements into clear, structured inputs for the delivery team.
• Support demand clarification and backlog prioritization in partnership with senior Product Managers and engineering leads.
• Contribute to the development and maintenance of product backlogs, ensuring user needs are clearly articulated.
• Work with Technology teams to support delivery of solutions that leverage AI and automation to improve margin processes.
• Participate in user demos, showcases, and walkthroughs of new functionality.
• Actively support user adoption, gathering feedback and helping teams understand and embed new solutions.
• Track and communicate basic outcomes of delivered changes (e.g. usability improvements, reduced manual effort).
• Support compliance with risk, control, and security requirements by working with relevant stakeholders.
• Assist with audit or control activities by helping ensure documentation and evidence are up to date.

jobs.title: Product Specialist – Distribution Oversight
jobs.description:
Do you want to operate at the intersection of risk, regulation, and global fund distribution, with direct exposure to senior stakeholders and Board-level reporting?
We’re looking for a high-ownership Product Specialist to strengthen our Distribution Oversight function. This role requires a strong sense of accountability, attention to detail, and the ability to operate independently in a regulated environment.

We’re looking for a Product Specialist – Distribution Oversight to:

• Conduct onboarding and ongoing due diligence on Funds Distributors (“delegates”)
• Drive ongoing monitoring activities (e.g. KPIs, control reviews, deep dives, and onsite assessments), ensuring consistency, quality, and timely execution
• Perform risk assessments of delegates, clearly identifying issues, proposing pragmatic remediation actions, and following them through to closure
• Produce high-quality reporting for senior management and Boards of Directors, ensuring accuracy, clarity, and strong documentation standards
• Challenge and enhance the control framework, proactively identifying gaps, inefficiencies, and improvement opportunities
• Ensure compliance with applicable regulatory frameworks (e.g. AML, UCITS/AIF requirements) across multiple jurisdictions
• Actively contributes to process simplification and automation, identifying opportunities to leverage tools (e.g. Copilot, Excel automation, data analytics) to improve efficiency and control quality

jobs.title: Local Credit Risk Officer, Korea
jobs.description:
Are you a strategic thinker with a passion for financial analysis and risk management?

We’re seeking a proactive and analytical (Director) to join our Investment Banking Risk Control team in Seoul. In this part-time role (50%), you will act as the UBS Securities, Seoul Branch CRO, which includes the following responsibilities:
• Chairing and preparing minutes for the local Risk Management Control Committee and attending monthly management meetings.
• Oversight and submission of regulatory reporting.
• Management of local liquidity risk management guidelines, involvement in the semi-annual liquidity stress test.
• Oversight of the monthly credit stress test.
• Internal/Regulatory inquiries related to Korea Risk in general.

jobs.title: Client Relationship Manager
jobs.description:
Do you have a track record of successfully managing client relationships? Are you able to create collaborative solutions in challenging and complex situations? Do you have the knowledge and experience to drive the business development of our Singapore / South-East Asia client base?

We're looking for a client relationship manager in our Wholesale client coverage team to:

• represent the full scope of our asset management services to our wholesale clients
• implement the right strategy to meet sales targets and generate revenues
• retain and develop client relationships, as well as guard against risk exposure
• focus on promoting [products e.g. mutual funds, hedge funds, real estate funds]
• proactively identify new business opportunities from our existing and prospect clients
• create and implement a strategic client book development plan that facilitates appropriate investment solutions
• collaborate with internal colleagues and support the efforts of our third-party relationships

Als Remote Advisor Mortgage bist du die erste Anlaufstelle für Neukundinnen, die sich mit einer der wichtigsten finanziellen Entscheidungen ihres Lebens beschäftigen – der Finanzierung ihres Eigenheims. Mit deinem Fachwissen, deiner Begeisterung für den Vertrieb und deiner Fähigkeit, Vertrauen aufzubauen, begleitest du Kundinnen von der ersten Beratung bis zum Abschluss. Gemeinsam mit einem engagierten Team und modernsten digitalen Tools machst du die Hypothekarberatung von morgen erfolgreich.

Deine Aufgaben:
• Du berätst Neukund*innen zu Hypothekengeschäften – flexibel, digital und immer mit einem offenen Ohr für ihre individuellen Bedürfnisse.
• Du gewinnst aktiv neue Kund*innen im Affluent-Segment und baust langfristige Beziehungen auf.
• Du führst Finanzierungsgespräche, prüfst Kreditanfragen und entwickelst passgenaue Finanzierungslösungen.
• Du kooperierst mit externen Finders (z. B. Immobilienmakler, Vermittler), um Leads zu generieren und erfolgreich abzuschliessen.
• Du stellst sicher, dass alle regulatorischen Vorgaben und Compliance-Standards eingehalten werden.

jobs.title: Business Strategist
jobs.description:
Are you a strategic thinker with strong analytical capabilities and a passion for driving complex M&A transactions? Do you combine rigorous financial analysis with the ability to deliver clear insights to senior stakeholders?

We’re looking for an Associate Director to:

• support and selectively lead strategic M&A initiatives across UBS Group
• identify, evaluate and execute M&A transactions and related strategic projects end-to-end
• conduct detailed market research, financial analysis and valuation work to assess potential targets and strategic options
• develop and maintain complex financial models to support decision-making
• synthesize quantitative and qualitative analyses into clear, concise recommendations for senior management
• prepare high-quality presentations and materials for internal and external stakeholders
• collaborate closely with business divisions, group functions and external advisors

jobs.title: Private Equity Investment Associate
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy finding value in private markets?
Can you turn complex investment data into clear insights?
We are looking for an Private Equity, Investment Associate to:

• conduct market research and financial analysis for potential primary investments and fund commitments, with an understanding of and interest in secondary transactions and co-investments
• assist in the due diligence process, including reviewing fund documentation, analyzing investment track records, and evaluating deal structures
• prepare investment memoranda and recommendations for internal committees
• monitor portfolio performance and provide ongoing analysis of investments
• collaborate with team members to develop investment strategies and identify new opportunities
• maintain accurate investment records and assist with reporting requirements

jobs.title: Data Analytics Specialist
jobs.description:
Role:
This role will continue to drive key responsibilities within the STAAT Analytics team. The candidate will lead the development of scalable, insight-driven dashboards and advanced analytical solutions that empower strategic decision-making for financial advisory and market leadership. The role requires a strong ability to translate complex data into actionable insights, ensuring stakeholders have the tools and intelligence needed to optimize performance and identify growth opportunities.
Responsibilities :
• Apply a structured, analytical approach to address complex business challenges leveraging Python and SQL.
• Conduct comprehensive exploratory data analysis and develop predictive models to drive key strategic initiatives.
• Translate business requirements into actionable technical specifications and innovative data-driven solutions.
• Design, develop, and maintain interactive Power BI dashboards for real-time KPI tracking across financial advisory and market segments.
• Implement advanced dashboard features such as dynamic filtering, intuitive search functionality, and peer comparison tools to optimize user engagement.
• Integrate data from diverse sources, including ADW, BODI, and internal data marts, ensuring accuracy and consistency across analytics outputs.
• Automate data pipelines and reporting workflows using Python and Power BI, enhancing efficiency and reliability.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure analytics deliverables are aligned with overarching business objectives.

jobs.description:

• We’re looking for a Research Associate to:
• •convert industry knowledge into understandable investment opinions
• •build and maintain financial models to evaluate historical information and generate projections
• •conduct valuation analysis of Indian securities
• •provide investment recommendations based on modelling, valuation and risk assessments
• •remain current on market developments to help frame investment strategies
